sheet.summary: SEBI has ordered finfluencer Avadhut Sathe and his academy to refund ₹546.17 crore along with ₹67.87 crore in interest for offering unregistered investment advisory services disguised as stock market education. The regulatory probe revealed that participants were lured using cherry-picked, misleading testimonials of quick trading profits, while in reality the majority suffered net trading losses. For salaried Indian households, this order underscores that speculative trading courses promising to replace monthly salaries or generate easy wealth carry severe financial risks compared to disciplined, long-term avenues like mutual fund SIPs.
